# Every refusal happens before any RPC; the test checks the server saw none.

# Ambiguous paths.
! skygo plan task.yaml extra.yaml
stderr 'task accepts one path'
! skygo run task.yaml -f task.yaml
stderr 'task path given both as an argument and with --file'
! skygo plan
stderr 'task requires --file or a path argument'

# Mixed and malformed documents.
! skygo plan mixed.yaml
stderr 'task mixes skygo argv and SkyPilot run'
! skygo run native-resources.yaml
stderr 'field resources not found'
! skygo plan skypilot-native.yaml
stderr '^task yaml: unsupported at 2:1$'
! skygo plan duplicate.yaml
stderr '^task yaml: invalid run at 2:1$'
! skygo plan malformed.yaml
stderr '^decode task: '
stdin documents.yaml
! skygo run -
stderr '^task yaml: unsupported'

# Fields the lowerer cannot represent stay typed refusals.
! skygo plan autostop.yaml
stderr '^task yaml: unsupported resources.autostop at 3:13$'
! skygo run infra.yaml
stderr '^task yaml: unsupported resources.infra'
! skygo run nodes.yaml
stderr '^task yaml: unsupported num_nodes'
! skygo plan workdir.yaml
stderr '^task yaml: unsupported workdir at 2:10: requires a workdir reference$'
! skygo plan task.yaml --shell sh
stderr 'shell must be a clean absolute path'

-- task.yaml --
run: echo
-- extra.yaml --
run: echo
-- mixed.yaml --
argv: [echo]
run: echo
-- native-resources.yaml --
argv: [echo]
resources:
  cpus: 1
-- skypilot-native.yaml --
run: echo
cpu_millis: 5
-- duplicate.yaml --
run: echo
run: echo
-- malformed.yaml --
argv: [echo
-- documents.yaml --
run: echo
---
run: echo
-- autostop.yaml --
run: echo
resources:
  autostop: 10
-- infra.yaml --
run: echo
resources:
  infra: k8s
-- nodes.yaml --
run: echo
num_nodes: 2
-- workdir.yaml --
run: echo
workdir: .
